title: Kolaboro data contracts
description: One JSON Schema (2020-12) per public dataset under https://kolaboro.com/data/, in $defs keyed by dataset id (see /data/catalog.json). Validate a file with {"$ref": "https://kolaboro.com/data/schemas/kolaboro-data.schema.json#/$defs/<id>"}, or fetch one schema alone from /api/x/data/schema/<id>.json. Written from the files as published on 5 Nov 2026 and checked against the live files every day (results: /data/contracts.json).

a11y.title: Accessibility audit
a11y.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/a11y.json. axe-core audit of every page (WCAG 2.2 AA rules) with counts per rule and page and the run history.

bali-cases.title: Tracked off-plan projects (anonymous)
bali-cases.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/bali-cases.json. Every off-plan project Kolaboro tracks, one record per anonymous project id: market, country, stage, price band, promised handover year, the six public checks (permit, deposit protection, progress, plans, track record, no guaranteed returns), how far each is confirmed, claims tested, flags and the change history. Advertised claims, not verified facts. The same data is served filtered by /api/open/projects.

bali-claims.title: What developers advertise in Bali
bali-claims.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/bali-claims.json. The same aggregate as world-claims for the Bali market alone: title and lease terms, guaranteed-return language, permit claims and numbers, plans and advertised prices.

benchmark-file.title: AI desk review benchmark, one file
benchmark-file.description: Contract of each JSON file under https://kolaboro.com/data/benchmark/. Results of the desk review benchmark on fixed fictional cases, one file per model (Haiku, Sonnet), each case answer signed with the Kolaboro Ed25519 key.

builds.title: Reproducible worker builds
builds.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/builds.json. Deterministic bundle of the site worker for each worker source tree that went live, built twice in clean folders; reproduced says whether both builds were identical.

changes.title: Change heatmap
changes.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/changes.json. Day by day, the last published bali-cases.json of each day compared with the previous day's copy: new projects, page edits (page fingerprint changed), price band moves, date moves and register changes, counted per market over rolling windows. A project counts once per kind and market in a window.

chaos.title: Chaos drills
chaos.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/chaos.json. Weekly fault-injection drills of the desk review (for example the primary AI reader down): what was forced, what was expected, what happened, and what is not covered.

coast-tiles-file.title: Coastline outline tiles, one file
coast-tiles-file.description: Contract of each JSON file under https://kolaboro.com/data/coast/. Natural Earth 1:10m land outline (public domain, via world-atlas 2.0.2) cut into 10 degree tiles, quantised and delta-encoded, used by the hazards check only when no OpenStreetMap server answers. Every tile exists; open-ocean tiles are empty.

company-graph.title: Company and director graph (UK)
company-graph.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/company-graph.json. Anonymised company and director graph for tracked projects whose developer is a UK company found on Companies House by exact name. Counts and anonymised nodes only.

company-graph-global.title: Global company graph (GLEIF)
company-graph-global.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/company-graph-global.json. For each tracked project: whether the companies named as developer have a Legal Entity Identifier, their parents and countries, as counts and booleans only. Source GLEIF (CC0).

delay-index.title: Delivery delay index
delay-index.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/delay-index.json. How far tracked off-plan projects are behind the first handover date on record, by market, with rules, caveats and monthly history.

deploys.title: Deploy guard record
deploys.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/deploys.json. Each deploy of the site: smoke checks after it went live, and any automatic rollback.

digest.title: Weekly market digest
digest.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/digest.json. Per ISO week: new projects, changes and alerts by market, built from the public bali-cases, promises, register-checks and stalled-sites files. An AI model may draft only the intro paragraph, and code checks every number in it.

domain-age.title: Website age of project pages
domain-age.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/domain-age.json. For each project whose page is on its own website: domain registration date (RDAP) and earliest TLS certificate (Certificate Transparency), at month precision. No domains are published.

hazards.title: Natural hazards at tracked projects
hazards.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/hazards.json. Elevation, flood depth, earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanoes and coastline distance for tracked projects with coordinates and watched areas, rounded so they cannot pinpoint a plot. Sources listed in the file.

image-hashes.title: Perceptual image hashes
image-hashes.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/image-hashes.json. 64-bit difference hashes of the images kept by the weekly render-reuse run, so anyone can check whether a picture appears on a tracked project page.

image-index.title: Render index
image-index.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/image-index.json. Perceptual hashes of images found on the websites the research agent reads, used to check whether a picture a buyer was sent also appears elsewhere.

insolvency-es-index.title: Spanish insolvency index (hashed)
insolvency-es-index.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/insolvency-es-index.json. Insolvency acts published in BORME Section One, keyed by a truncated SHA-256 of the normalised company name so the file is not a readable list of companies; anyone can test a name against it. Source BOE, reuse with attribution.

insolvency-watch.title: Insolvency watch
insolvency-watch.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/insolvency-watch.json. Daily check of UK and Spanish developer companies against insolvency notices (The Gazette, BORME). Each hit is reduced to date, source and type of notice; no company names.

journeys.title: Synthetic user journeys
journeys.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/journeys.json. A scripted buyer journey run in a real browser every hour: pass or fail per step, timings and the latest screenshots (journeys/1.webp to 5.webp).

kolaboro-parquet-manifest.title: Parquet export manifest
kolaboro-parquet-manifest.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/kolaboro.parquet.json. Columns, row counts, sizes and SHA-256 of the two Parquet files and the SHA-256 of the bali-cases.json they were built from. A signed copy is served by /api/x/e/parquet-manifest.

lighthouse.title: Lighthouse scores
lighthouse.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/lighthouse.json. Lighthouse runs per page and form factor with thresholds and flags.

market-points.title: Market points for the map
market-points.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/market-points.json. One public point per market (not per project), from Natural Earth and GeoNames, used to place anonymous projects on the map. Private per-project coordinates are never used.

mystery-shopper.title: Mystery shopper programme
mystery-shopper.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/mystery-shopper.json. Questionnaire, measurement rules and status of the mystery shopper programme. It has not started; the file says why.

night-lights.title: Night lights at finished projects
night-lights.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/night-lights.json. NASA Black Marble night-time light at projects that should be finished, compared with the surrounding ring, monthly for 36 months. Light is a proxy, not proof of occupancy.

on-time.title: On-time handover odds
on-time.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/on-time.json. For each project: will it hand over within 6 months of the first date on record? Estimated from closed comparable projects with a 95% interval, plus validation and the bias of the sample.

page-weight.title: Page weight
page-weight.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/page-weight.json. Bytes transferred for one cold load of key pages (compressed size plus headers, measured in Chrome), first-party bytes split by resource type, against page-weight budgets.

price-index.title: Asking-price index
price-index.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/price-index.json. Chained index of advertised asking prices ("from" prices on developer and listing pages) per market, with daily snapshots, rules and caveats. Not transaction prices.

price-reality.title: Advertised versus registered prices
price-reality.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/price-reality.json. Advertised starting prices compared with officially registered sales where a government publishes them: counts, quartiles and medians only, converted to USD at a cited rate. Lists the markets not covered.

progress-sample.title: Sample photo progress analysis
progress-sample.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/progress-sample.json. One stored example answer of the photo progress check, used on the demo page.

projects-sample.title: Fictional sample score
projects-sample.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/projects.json. One fictional project (marked fictional: true) used to demonstrate the score page. Not real data.

promise-drift.title: Promise drift on developer pages
promise-drift.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/promise-drift.json. Day by day, which advertised values changed on each tracked developer page (handover date, prices, units and other fields), from fingerprinted page text. No URLs or names.

promises.title: Dated developer promises
promises.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/promises.json. Every dated promise a developer made about a tracked project (handover, construction start, structure, other milestones, permits, rental programme), read from the research records, with its status today. Per project and per market.

property-tests.title: Property-based tests of the scoring rules
property-tests.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/property-tests.json. Property-based tests and fuzzing of the open scoring rules, counted by the test run itself.

qa.title: Site QA crawl
qa.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/qa.json. Daily crawl of every page and link with the checks that ran and any problems found.

register-checks.title: Official register checks
register-checks.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/register-checks.json. Every official register linked on /registers/: whether our checker could read it (time, HTTP status, size and SHA-256 of the bytes received), and per project the register result, with a hash-chained lookup archive.

render-reuse.title: Reused renders across projects
render-reuse.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/render-reuse.json. Pairs of images that appear on the pages of two different tracked projects on different domains (CLIP image embeddings, cosine 0.85 or more, confirmed by feature matching), with what was excluded and why.

restore.title: Backup restore drill
restore.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/restore.json. Weekly drill: the latest database backup is restored into a clean PostgreSQL and checked table by table, and evidence files are re-hashed.

risk.title: Risk patterns
risk.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/risk.json. Which tracked projects look unusual on public warning signs compared with all others, and why, with a model card. It ranks; it does not predict. No project has a confirmed outcome to train on.

roadmap.title: Product roadmap
roadmap.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/roadmap.json. The public product roadmap: each item with its number, theme, title, short description and status.

roadmap-sync.title: Roadmap items verified live
roadmap-sync.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/roadmap-sync.json. Roadmap items that link to the live page delivering them. An item counts as shipped only when the page answers HTTP 200, its canonical link is that page and its HTML contains the marker text.

satellite.title: Satellite watch (Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1)
satellite.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/satellite.json. Sentinel-2 vegetation and clearing per season and Sentinel-1 radar backscatter change for every watched site and area (boxes of about 1 km). Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

satellite-optical.title: Monthly optical progress series
satellite-optical.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/satellite-optical.json. Per watched site and month from January 2023: cloud-masked Sentinel-2 median, built_pct (built-up or bare ground, which look alike at 10 m) and new built-up since the baseline month. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

security-scan.title: Security scan
security-scan.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/security-scan.json. OWASP ZAP baseline passive scan of kolaboro.com: alerts by risk.

shipping.title: Shipping log
shipping.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/shipping.json. Ships (commits by people, or by Claude working for one) and data updates per UTC day from the git history of the live branch, streaks, engineering metrics and day summaries written by an AI model and checked in code.

similar.title: Similar projects
similar.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/similar.json. For every public project, the 5 most similar other public projects: ids and rounded scores only (text similarity from an open sentence-embedding model run on the GitHub runner, plus structured similarity). Input is only the public bali-cases.json.

site-manifest.title: Site manifest
site-manifest.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/site-manifest.json. SHA-256 of every file published on kolaboro.com outside /data/, computed from the git commit the live site was serving.

stalled-sites.title: Stalled construction sites
stalled-sites.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/stalled-sites.json. Sentinel-2 change between clear quarters in a 150 m window around every project with coordinates, and which sites show almost no change.

verifiers.title: Independent verifier run
verifiers.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/verifiers.json. Three independent implementations (JavaScript, Python, Go) check the test vectors and the live log, checkpoint, proofs and signatures.

visual-diff.title: Visual changes on developer pages
visual-diff.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/visual-diff.json. Where the pages of tracked developer websites visibly changed, as page geometry only. No screenshots are published because they would identify anonymous projects.

visual-tests.title: Visual regression tests
visual-tests.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/visual-tests.json. Key pages captured in Chromium at 390 and 1440 px and compared pixel by pixel with the previous run, with the share of changed pixels per page.

world-claims.title: What developers advertise, by market
world-claims.description: Contract of https://kolaboro.com/data/world-claims.json. Per market: how many tracked projects, title and lease terms advertised, guaranteed-return language, permit claims, permit numbers and plans published, and advertised USD prices. Aggregates only.
